_schema._comment: CE course catalog for compliance-gap recommendations. Add entries as affiliate deals are signed (or as plain vetted links — set sponsored:false). Empty catalog renders nothing anywhere.
_schema.title: course title as the provider lists it
_schema.url: the link — your affiliate/tracking URL once a deal exists
_schema.sponsored: true if the url earns a referral fee (renders disclosure + rel=sponsored)
_schema.category: mandatory-category key it satisfies — must match stateRules category keys, e.g. 'implicitBias', 'culturalCompetency', 'alzheimers', 'ethics', or 'general'
_schema.states: array of state codes where accepted, e.g. ['IL','WI'] — or ['*'] for all covered states
